name: Unitas Orcklespock
description: A kaiju blooded farmer curoius to learn more about the world and his place in it.
notes: A somewhat devotee of the Knight.

name: Sahaero Barman
description: A run away prince, trying to out run his past and find his lover.

name: Seldorl Barirahl
description: A drow trying to forget bloodlust and finding a new path of peace and justice.
notes: A newly coverted paladin of the Queen.

name: Jasper Arkose
description: A paladin who will not stop till he reclaims the throne of Reiwa.

name: Zettai
description: A kaiju blooded who's mutations have stopped for now by the Flesh.

name: Azarn
description: A tiefling who wants revenge on his noble family.

name: Aliban
description: A very curious aasimar who wants to learn more about his lienage with the Bug.

name: Jet Jaguar
description: A hero of Gojirin who has joined forces to stop the threats that have popped up again on the island.

name: Ichi
description: A masked warrior of the Dragon, leader of his three main paladins.

name: Ni
description: A masked warrior of the Dragon, second of his three main paladins.

name: San
description: A masked warrior of the Dragon, third of his three main paladins.

name: Baragon
description: A miner from the town of Cupad caught himself up with the fate of the island.

name: Gilfred
description: A large centipede who was helped and became the pet of Aliban.

name: The King
description: The leader of the gods, he's a god of respect and honor, and is the one who has been keeping the peace between the gods and the mortals.

name: The Shield
description: The ruler of Showa, he is a god of protection and is considerer a hero to the people of Gojirin.

name: The Queen
description: The partner of the King, she is a goddess of healing and love, and is known to rebirth if she is killed.

name: The Phoenix
class: Focus on fire and the sun.
description: The god who lives in the volcano known as Mount Sun, he is the god of fire and the sun. He's been known not to bow under any god unless they prove themselves.

name: The Dragon
description: The god of conquest, he is a god who wants to rule over all of gojirin, making everyone else bow to him and him only.

name: The Flesh
description: The god of flesh, he is a god who wants to consume all of gojirin, making everyone and eveything him.

name: The Knight
class: Focus on the spirit of fighting and winning.
description: The god of the knightly spirit, he is a god who values honor and victory. No battle shall end without a winner.

name: The Bug
class: Focus on the earth itself and the under dark of Gojirin.
description: The god of the ground, he protects the land and all that dwell within it.

name: The Mech
description: The god of technology, he is a god who values progress and improvement. He is known to be a god who is always looking for ways to improve the lives of the people of Gojirin.

name: The Monk
description: The god of peace, he is a god who values harmony and tranquility. He resides in his temple in the moutains of Reiwa.

name: The Plant
description: The goddess of the plants and life, she is a goddess who values animals and the natural world.

name: The Grim Reaper?
description: Unknown.

name: The Crystal
description: The god of fear, he is a god who values power and control. He is known to be a god who is always looking for ways to instill fear in the people of Heisei to keep them in check.

name: The Devil
description: The god of destruction, he is a god who values chaos and anarchy.

name: The Shapeshifter
description: The god of perfection, he is known to take from the best of all the others and use their strengths upon himself.

name: The Keizer
description: Unknown.

name: The Blizzard
description: The goddess of the ice and water who has been missing for centries. Once the original ruler of Reiwa.

name: The Forgotten
description: The god of revenge, he is a god who values pure anger and get back at those who wronged him.

name: Zagreth
description: The leader of the hedoron cult who hides his face beneath a hood.
